Lay on Hands Charge is a class-specific resource for Paladins.

Overview

Lay on Hands Charges are a limited resource that allow paladins to use their Lay on Hands class actions. These charges can be spent to heal allies or cure harmful conditions.

Paladins gain 3 Lay on Hands Charges at level 1 and an additional charge at levels 4 and 10, for a total of 5.

Recovering Lay on Hands Charges

Lay on Hands Charges are fully replenished on a Long Rest or respeccing with Withers.

Actions using Lay on Hands Charges

Name Cost/Recharge Range/Area Effect
Lay on Hands: Cure + 2  Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Cure all diseases and poisons
Lay on Hands: Greater Healing + 2  Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) 4 × (Paladin level)⁠⁠Hit Points
Lay on Hands: Lesser Healing +  Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) 2 × (Paladin level)⁠⁠Hit Points
